title: The committee appointment and follow-up arrangements
summary: He explains committee work and offers to make cassettes with extra answers.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I'll tell you what I wish you'd do, when you have an opportunity, just to drop my name around in circles. Because this was a hell of a thing for me to get that...I didn't have no idea they were going to put me on the committee. And this is a big thing. It has to do with that Third World Building on 125th Street, and it has to do with the African third world nations and countries and it can be very, very important. It can...and it don't hurt me any, because I would have time, more time now, to devote to, you know what I mean, to civic-minded things, and then some of them will turn into money and some of them won't. Everything can't be money.

So I'm going to...now what, what I want to say to you is that if you feel like it, that you need...that there are some points that you'd like to have covered. Now I'll be here until the 15th. Just simply send me a quick note or call me or send me a telegram. I'll make a cassette, and you'll have it. If there's some thing...for example, I don't know if you
covered everything. Did we cover everything that you...?
We covered everything that I have on the paper, yeah.
But sometimes, you know, when you get a...God knows, I forgot to ask him about so and so.

But if you do, you just call me. And I've got PR and 21 people in the office, and Roger and them are here, and Sharon, and, you know, I'll take down what you want and then I will make a tape. And it don't have to be one time...maybe two or three times.
You may want a point of clarification.
Right. Right. But you...in any case, enough when you come back you'll probably have the transcript by then.
Well, I'll be back in May or June.
You going for a long time?
Yeah, we're going to open that club in Switzerland, in Bern. In Schweitzhauer. You know Switzerland?
Not well, but I've been...yes, I know, I've been there... been to Zürich.
